scorecard.grade_rationale: 7 P1 findings exceed the C-grade threshold of max_p1:2. Grading config: D = max_p1:999.

escalations.title: protobufjs — 12 Critical Code Injection & RCE CVEs
Handlebars.js — Multiple Template Injection & Prototype Pollution CVEs
escalations.fix: Update handlebars; verify no runtime template processing from untrusted input
escalations.notes: Likely build-time only; requires TheGuardians to verify runtime usage

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing — Access Control Bypass
escalations.fix: Update express/body-parser; implement credential-based auth for sensitive endpoints
escalations.notes: CRITICAL: /api/metrics endpoint must not rely solely on IP whitelisting

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Server Crash & Certificate Validation Bypass
escalations.notes: Critical for mTLS scenarios; certificate bypass is exploitable

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ codebase
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer hardcodes source_dirs=["Source","E2E"] — portal/ codebase invisible. All 6 portal plans report 100% failure on a false negative. Blocks every agent running verification gates for portal/ features.
p1_findings.fix: Add 'portal' to source_dirs list in tools/traceability-enforcer.py — one-line change.

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI — Arbitrary File Read & Execution
p1_findings.fix: Update vitest; disable UI server; restrict network access
p1_findings.notes: Only risk if UI server is exposed or running in CI

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-api-types: blocked_by field missing from UpdateBugInput/UpdateFeatureRequestInput
p2_findings.detail: blocked_by?: string[] absent from both input types; two as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx as workaround.
p2_findings.fix: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both types in portal/Shared/api.ts; remove as any casts.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts does not exist
p2_findings.detail: Seed file required by FR-dependency-seed for 8 known dependency relationships is missing. No demo state; tests expecting known relationships will fail on fresh DB.
p2_findings.fix: Create seed.ts with idempotent insert logic; call during server startup after schema migration.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-frontend-tests: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx missing
p2_findings.detail: Two production components (DependencySection 226 lines, BlockedBadge 70 lines) have no test coverage. FR-dependency-frontend-tests explicitly requires both.
p2_findings.fix: Create both test files following DependencyPicker.test.tsx pattern.

p2_findings.title: body-parser — Denial of Service via Invalid Limit Bypass
p2_findings.fix: Verify size limits; update to latest

p2_findings.title: form-data — CRLF Injection in Multipart Field Names
js-yaml — Quadratic Complexity DoS in Merge Key Handling
@remix-run/router — Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
p2_findings.fix: Update react-router-dom to >=6.26.0; audit redirect() calls

p3_findings.title: DependencyPicker.test.tsx uses non-existent FR-0001 traceability ID
p3_findings.fix: Replace all FR-0001 with FR-dependency-picker throughout file

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions masking dependency array bugs in production hooks
p3_findings.fix: Audit suppressed hooks; add missing deps or document intentional suppression

p3_findings.title: Silent JSON parse error swallow in api/client.ts catch
p3_findings.fix: Log parse failure at debug level before returning {}

p3_findings.title: Two parallel FR namespaces (FR-WF-* vs FR-NNN) risk collision across codebases
p3_findings.fix: Clarify FR namespace ownership in CLAUDE.md; consider prefixing portal requirements

p3_findings.title: 67 moderate CVEs across 5 npm projects (dependency hygiene)

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Update @grpc/grpc-js to >=1.14.5 in portal/Backend and platform/orchestrator
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 15 CVEs (12 protobufjs + 3 grpc-js) in one update

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Update vitest to >=2.1.0+ in Source/Frontend and portal/Backend
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 2 RCE CVEs and arbitrary file read; also closes tinypool chain

cross_reference_map.root_cause: portal/ directory not in traceability enforcer scan dirs
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Unblocks all portal/ feature verification gates; exposes true spec coverage for 6 plans

cross_reference_map.root_cause: proxy-addr vulnerability in shared Express dependency
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Update express and body-parser across all 3 Express projects + add credential-based auth for /api/metrics
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Closes IP spoofing + DoS vectors in Source/Backend, portal/Backend, platform/orchestrator
